title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui carries the view and action judgment of cloud's private corpus — a view added beside the list, the empty board over a new group field, a button whose body writes (#31155, port 3/3)
body:
Part of #31155 — card 1 of 4 of the objectstack-ai/cloud#3659 ruling-A split; this is the third and last per-domain port (`objectstack-ui`), after #31223 (`objectstack-data`) and #31393 (`objectstack-automation`). It closes the card's port work; the card stays open for the seat's close-out.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把云端私有搭建语料里「UI」这一块、schema 表达不了的四条判断搬进公开的 `objectstack-ui` skill:① 「加一个看板/日历/画廊/甘特视图」= 新建一个 `listViews` 条目(键名编码种类,如 `status_kanban`),默认 `list` 原样保留,只有用户明说「改成/换成」才原地改种类;② 按刚新建的字段分组的看板首次打开是空的——已有记录全落在最后的 `Uncategorized` 泳道,交付时要说明(并更正云端原文:SQL 数据源上字面量 `defaultValue` 会成为新列的 DEFAULT,已有行会读到它);③ 「标记完成/审批/提交」这类操作是 `action` 元数据不是视图,写按钮的 body 必须真的调用 `ctx.api.object(OBJ).update`(`language: 'js'` + `api.write`),只 return 新值什么都不会写;④ 用户点名的视图种类(画廊/甘特/看板)照建,不降级成表格。外加 3 条 eval 用例;顺手把 `rules/navigation.md`、`rules/record-page.md` 残留的中文改成英文。净增 65 行。
- 为什么改:执行 cloud#3659 裁决 A(一个知识源:本地开发与云端 AI 用同一套公开 skills)。第 ② 条云端原文「defaultValue 只对新记录生效、不影响已有记录」对照 `main` 的 SQL 驱动是错的(`applyDeclaredColumnDefault` 把字面量默认值写进 ADD COLUMN 的 DEFAULT),本 PR 按运行时真实行为搬入,并在卡上记了更正。
- 风险与回滚:只改文档与 eval 夹具,无运行时改动;四个 token 棘轮行按实测钉住(两行抬高、两行降低,依据 cloud#3659 A 与「先削重复,余额按实测提高」,同文件先删了重复)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`(新段落 Adding a board…,尤其 (c) 那句对照 `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-schema-sync.ts` `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` 与 `sql-driver-rotation.ts` 的 ADD COLUMN 路径)、`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`(§ Actions 新段,对照 `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts` 的 `api.write` 门与 `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` 的 `action-record-write-discarded`)、`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`(四行)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期全绿且 objectstack-ui 四行 headroom 0;`python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json'))"` 不报错。
- 需要你做的:Tier H 受管面(`skills/**`),需要你的 APPROVED review 后由席位落地;本 PR 保持 draft。

## What changes

Six files under `skills/objectstack-ui/`, one changeset, four token-ratchet rows. Every sentence was checked against `packages/spec` and the runtime on `main` (merged in at 708922f9); the one private sentence that was false is ported corrected (below).

- `rules/list-views.md` — a new section after the kanban config, **Adding a board, calendar, gallery or gantt beside the list** (add-view-not-convert): "add a kanban / calendar / gallery / gantt view" is a NEW `listViews` entry whose key encodes its kind (`status_kanban`, `timeline_gantt`: the key a nav item's `viewName` names, registered as `OBJECT.status_kanban`), the default `list` and every other view untouched; retyping `list` to satisfy an add converts it in place and nothing refuses it; a kind changes in place only when the request says to convert or replace THAT view. Beneath it, **A board over a field added in the same change opens empty** (19f): adding a field writes nothing into existing rows, so every pre-existing record lands in the trailing `Uncategorized` lane — the populated lane last, past the right edge of a narrow screen, under a non-zero count; the renderer's correct fallback, not lost data; the three-part hand-over (all in the last lane, scroll right; dragging a card out writes the field, or edit from the list; what a `defaultValue` does to existing rows); the same disclosure when a list is converted into such a board. Same-file pay-downs first: the kanban example's `// required on every list view` comment (the sentence above it says it), the `userFilters` bullet's "Need named presets on an object? Add a `listViews` entry instead" (the bullet before it), "the saved-views switcher already covers presets" (same bullet), the search example's `searchableFields: []` comment (the table row above it), the narrowing sentence's "refuses the request" clause (the ⛔ section below it), the two Data Source code comments (the blockquote under them), the `summary` comment's "footer aggregation" (the Column Features row).
- `SKILL.md` § View Types — **Keep the kind the request names** (the PORT clause of auto-surfaced): a photo wall / card wall / catalogue of covers is `gallery` with an image, avatar or file field as `gallery.coverField`, a schedule or timeline over a start/end pair is `gantt`, a board is `kanban`; never downgrade a named kind to `grid` — the file parses and the user opens a table where they asked for a board; a pointer to the new list-views section.
- `SKILL.md` § Actions — **An operation is an `action`, never a view** (13): "mark as done", "approve", "submit", "set status to X" is `defineAction` metadata, a view only displays; a record button carries `objectName` (what folds it into the object's record surfaces) and `locations` (with neither `locations` nor a view naming it in `rowActions` / `bulkActions` it renders nowhere — `action-no-placement`); **a write button must write**: `ctx.record` is a read-only snapshot and the body's return value is applied to nothing, so a body that only returns the new values or assigns to `ctx.record` changes nothing and still reports success (`action-record-write-discarded`); the shape that writes is `type: 'script'` with `body: { language: 'js', source: "await ctx.api.object('task').update({ id: ctx.recordId, status: 'done' });", capabilities: ['api.write'] }` — `js` because an `expression` body is a pure formula with no I/O, `api.write` because the sandbox throws on `ctx.api…update` / `insert` / `delete` without it, the option `value` never its label; a multi-step operation is `type: 'flow'` with `target` naming a flow you also author. Same-file pay-downs first: the intro paragraph restating the frontmatter description, the "Load objectstack-formula" sentence restating the frontmatter, Common Pitfalls 1–2 restating `rules/list-views.md` § Column Features (one pointer item now), the blueprint row's `slotted` / `full` clause restating the Detailed Rules line, the duplicated "canonical reference" sentence, the App-navigation row's gloss.
- `rules/navigation.md`, `rules/record-page.md` — English only (below); each file's ceiling LOWERED to its measurement.
- `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` — cases 13 (a board added beside the list over a just-added `priority` select, with the empty-board disclosure), 14 (a "Mark as done" button whose body calls `ctx.api.object('task').update` with `api.write`), 15 (a photo wall is `type: 'gallery'` with `gallery.coverField`); `evals/README.md` names them. `must_not_contain` entries are the shape a wrong answer writes (`defineView(`, `list: { type: 'kanban'`, `language: 'expression'`, `type: 'grid'`), the form `main` narrowed the fixtures to; no entry appears in its own `expected_output`.
- `.changeset/31155-port-authoring-rules-ui.md` — `@objectstack/skills` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — four rows (table below).

**Language scope (approver os-zhuang on #31223, verbatim 「skills 对外发布的版本应该全部用英文」; the account owner's 「同意」):** every non-eval file this PR touches holds 0 CJK code points at the head (Python scan over the CJK Unified, kana, fullwidth and CJK-punctuation blocks), and so do the lines it adds to the ratchet script. The two pre-existing carriers in this skill are English now: `rules/navigation.md` ("a simplified screen for the business team", "workbench" in the interface-page signal list) and `rules/record-page.md` (the record page's second tab is `Activity`, the console's own label — `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`, `t('detail.timeline', { defaultValue: 'Activity' })`). Eval prompts keep their language under exemption (a); `objectstack-i18n` untouched (b). The catalog's remaining carriers (`objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`, `objectui/guides/i18n.md`) are not this PR's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Cloud corpus text that is false against this repo's runtime (carrier: cloud, card 4 cloud#3714 or a cloud card):** rule 19f's clause (c), quoted in the table. The hosted agent today tells the user a literal `defaultValue` changes nothing about existing rows; on a SQL datasource it does.
- **Observation, not filed (class: none of (a)/(b)/(c) as measured here; carrier: none):** `applyDeclaredColumnDefault` makes a literal `defaultValue` behave differently per datasource on a field added to an existing table — SQL dialects fill the existing rows through the column DEFAULT, the memory and mongodb drivers do not — and the spec's `defaultValue` describe ("applied on INSERT") does not mention the DDL half. The driver's own docblock names exactly this split as the reason it does NOT emit an option-level `default: true`. Read from source only; no end-to-end probe was run, so it stays an observation for the seat.
- **E/R row 8 of the v1 ledger** (dashboard `dimensions` over a multi-value field, "verify") reads as enforced on `main`: `rules/dashboards.md` states `INVALID_FIELD` for `groupBy` and `DATASET_INVALID` at compile for a dataset dimension over one. Recorded here; the ledger note on the card says so.
- Eval `must_contain` tokens `groupByField: 'priority'`, `ctx.recordId`, `coverField: 'main_image'` are prompt-specific values, as `applicant_email` / `signed_copy` are in earlier cases; the root catalog has no taught-token oracle (that gate scans `ui/skills` only).
- The dispatch said `rules/navigation.md` carried 13 CJK lines and `rules/record-page.md` 4; on the branch base both carried 2 (the counts above are code-point lines). Both are English now.
- Not ported, by class: the CLOUD halves above; the `objectName` lint half of 13 (no equivalent here, by contract).
